title: Support scoped wildcard permissions
task:
Roles should be able to hold a scoped wildcard such as `task:*`.

1. `can(roles, permission)` must treat `task:*` as granting every `task:` permission, and only those. A bare `*` is NOT a wildcard: it grants nothing, because a role that silently means "everything" is how an audit stops being possible.
2. `permissionsFor` keeps returning the literal permissions a role declares, sorted, without expanding wildcards — the expansion belongs to the check, not to the listing.
3. Deny-by-default is unchanged: an unknown role still grants nothing.
4. Add `test/permissions-wildcard.test.mjs` covering `task:*` granting `task:read`, `task:*` not granting `user:manage`, and a bare `*` granting nothing.

Session tokens are out of scope.
